entries.title: ACD Trigger Flow
causes: CATERR# hold triggers BMC ACD collection via OOBMSM
CATERR# pulse does not trigger ACD — Crash Log only

entries.title: Reset Blocking
causes: Unexpected platform reset interrupts ACD/Crashlog collection
OS warm reset during CATERR# hold ignored by design

entries.title: DSA Hang — Translation Queue Arbitration Deadlock
causes: Src1 fills all 112 translation queue entries; Src2 blocked; Reduce requires both → deadlock
Translation queue arbitration starvation above 448KB threshold

entries.title: UBR VN0 Credit Loss
causes: VN credit counters wrap; HAMVF timeout cascade into MCE
UBR VN0 credit counter overflow triggers uncorrected error

entries.title: SFI Poison Passthrough
causes: SFI poison detection only checks first 64B chunk; remainder passes silently

entries.title: DSA Gather Copy Completion Buffer Exhaustion
causes: Completion buffer fills with no descriptor completion — hang without MCA
